# Data Scientist I
Brightline Retail · Full-time

What you'll do

- Build demand forecasts for stores.
- Present findings to merchandising teams.

Requirements

- 1-3 years of experience.
- SQL and Python.
- Experience with forecasting or time series models.
- Machine learning with scikit-learn.
- Clear data visualization and communication.

Nice to have

- Experience with dbt.
- Snowflake or BigQuery.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Brightline Retail is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
